title: Temple of Zin-Malor
wikitext:
[[Image:Temple of Zin-Malor.jpg|thumb|Temple of Zin-Malor]]

'''Temple of Zin-Malor''' (aka '''Elune's temple''') is an ancient building situated in the [[Ruins of Eldarath]]. It was once a prominent [[night elven]] temple devoted to the worship of their goddess, [[Elune]]. Its similarity to the nearby [[Temple of Arkkoran]] is striking, as they both have a very similar design to the current [[Temple of the Moon]] in [[Darnassus]]. The temple is currently occupied by the [[Spitelash]] tribe of [[naga]] under the leadership of [[Warlord Krellian]], who himself inhabits the temple in a place of honor. The {{loot|Common|Crystal of Zin-Malor}} once rested here.
